items.title: Find the Region of a shelf
items.kills: "A shelf is global, so every Region sees it."
items.read_only_alternative: This task is read-only. It needs no alternative.

steps.text: Open the Amazon Widget Store console and find the list of shelves.
steps.expect: A list of shelves, or an empty list.

steps.text: Read the Region column of one shelf.
steps.expect: Each shelf shows exactly one Region.

steps.text: Change the Region of the console and look at the list again.
steps.expect: The shelf from the first Region is not in the list.

items.label: checked against docs, not run in a real account

items.title: Try to move a shelf to another Region
items.kills: "You can move a shelf when your team moves."
items.read_only_alternative: Do the Look task again in two Regions, and read the sentence about moving a shelf on the limits page.

steps.text: Create a shelf with the name saa-sample-shelf in your current Region.
steps.expect: The output shows the shelf name and your Region.

steps.text: Try to move the shelf to another Region.
steps.predict: What will the service answer when you ask it to move the shelf?
steps.explain: You [cannot move a shelf](../facts/widget.md#widget-shelf-move) to another Region.

steps.text: Copy the shelf to the other Region instead.
steps.command: aws widget copy-shelf --name saa-sample-shelf --target-region eu-west-1 --tags Key=book,Value=saa Key=task,Value=sample-t02
steps.expect: A second shelf exists in eu-west-1.

cleanup.text: Delete the copy in the other Region.

still_costs: A shelf that you did not delete, in either Region.
